author: andreaskarel
body: Hello, avicus servers staff. This is a permanent ban appeal. My most recent username is intertone, but my username when i was banned was andreaskarel550. The reason i was banned was for fly/glide hacks, on june 16 2014, 2:05 pm. The reason i think i should be unbanned, is that i really enjoyed playing at your servers, and i kind off miss it. I have stopped hacking after this "event". My email for further stuff isandreaskarel550.03@gmail.com. Thank you for your time. Update- I had post this again because i made a mistake of some sort. Sorry.
